purpose: Preserve exact control/evidence standing immediately before the System Master parent-hierarchy reallocation. This is a historical checkpoint, not current authority.
preservation_rules: Do not delete or rewrite historical branches, receipts, frozen evidence or exact-SHA qualification records as part of reallocation.

If a future audit disagrees with this snapshot, preserve both and resolve through explicit evidence rather than rewriting this record.
